Mia: Heads-up 10am QBR next Wed. Need a compact "pulse" slide + a short "bridge ask" per account for execs. Can we split prep?
Rahul: Ill own pulse + metrics for three at-risk accounts (Meridian, Harborline, TidalTech). Will pull last 30d usage and adoption.
Priya: I can do bridge asks and outreach plan. Will draft tailored asks (ops support, integration help, exec email).
Ben: I'll capture onboarding blockers and sequence owners. Quick note: Harborline still blocked on CS-4567 (API key rotation) and needs a 1:1 w/ infra.
Mia: Good. Can we include renewal signal bands (green/amber/red) and one-line rationale? Execs want a single slide per account.
Rahul: Proposed bands: Meridian = red (repeat latency incidents + drop in weekly active flows), Harborline = amber (onboarding lag but usage steady), TidalTech = green (expanding usage).
Priya: For bridge asks Im thinking: Meridian = customer success + eng war-room + 2-week pilot, Harborline = keys escalation + enablement session, TidalTech = case study ask.
Ben: Onboarding notes: Meridian onboarding 70% complete, stuck on integration testing. Ticket IDs: ONB-778, ONB-779. TidalTech completed onboarding and requested deeper prompt tuning session.
Mia: Can everyone drop their draft slide as PDF to the shared drive by Tue 3pm? Link: https://drive.redwood/qbr-drafts (tag doc with `qbr-draft`).
Rahul: Will upload metrics PDF by Tue 1pm. Also attaching a tiny CSV snippet in-thread for quick reference: `meridian_weekly_calls,2026-03-01,450
meridian_weekly_calls,2026-03-08,320`
Priya: I'll add exec asks plus suggested owners. Can someone confirm ARR to reference for each?
Ben: ARR numbers: Meridian $420k, Harborline $120k, TidalTech $60k.
Mia: Thanks. Action list (I'll manage master doc):
- Metrics pulse PDFs: Rahul 1 Tue 13:00
- Bridge asks + outreach draft: Priya 1 Tue 15:00
- Onboarding blockers + ticket status: Ben 1 Tue 12:00
- Slides uploaded to drive & link posted here: All 1 Tue 15:00
- Exec dry run: Wed 09:30 (30m) 1 all
Rahul: Quick ask 1 can eng lead for Meridian join the dry run? Need decision makers on call.
Mia: I'll invite Meris eng lead and the renewal AE.
OpsBot: Reminder sent: please tag uploads with `qbr-draft` and add reviewer names.
Priya: One more thing 1 capture direct customer feedback snippets on the pulse slide (quotes). Anyone have recent quotes?
Ben: Meridian quote from last week: "Latency spikes are blocking us from scaling." I'll anonymize and add it.
Mia: Great. If no other blockers, I'll lock the agenda and calendar invites. Thanks team.
Priya: :thumbsup: will post bridge-ask draft here when ready.

Mia: Closing thread 1 will ping if anything urgent comes up.
